source: Yahoo Finance v8 chart daily unadjusted open/close

definitions.open_to_close: close(D) / open(D) - 1; same horizon as next_session_open_to_close
definitions.latest_prior: U = max(US session date < Korean session date D); holidays/weekends carry latest US session
definitions.previous_calendar_day: U must equal D minus one calendar day; otherwise exclude D
definitions.flat_policy: Exact zero is flat: kept in baseline/conditional denominators, excluded from four quadrants and directional agreement numerator
definitions.baseline: Unconditional KOSPI sign ratio on exactly the same aligned sample; down lift uses the down baseline
definitions.missing_policy: Keep null source rows; exclude a matched pair if either target or either native previous close is missing. Both targets use identical complete-case samples; never fill prices or bridge a null session
definitions.units: Returns in percent; ratio value and CI in percent; lift in percentage points

confidence_interval.limitations: Exploratory; overlapping 1y/3y periods; no multiple-testing correction; block length is a sensitivity assumption

team_claim.source: User-supplied team summary; raw observations and exact period unavailable

limitations: Past association, not causality or a guarantee of future performance
Yahoo is a single vendor; missing entire sessions cannot be distinguished from exchange holidays without an independent exchange calendar
Holiday carry-forward can reuse US sessions; close-to-close includes the already-realized Korean opening gap
No transaction costs, individual-stock transfer, or out-of-sample predictive test
briefing_recommendation: 참고 통계: 2025-10-22~2026-10-22 코스피 243거래일에서, 직전 나스닥 상승 후 코스피 시가→종가 상승 비율은 46.6%(61/131일, 95% 블록 부트스트랩 구간 39.9~53.0%)였고, 같은 표본의 전체 상승일 비율은 50.6%였습니다. 휴장일에는 가장 최근 미국장을 연결하고 결측 가격이 있는 관측은 제외한 과거 통계이며, 인과관계나 향후 예측을 보장하지 않습니다.
